name: Differential Rendering for CT Reconstruction
definition: An iterative reconstruction method that optimizes 3D volume parameters (specifically absorption coefficient σ) by minimizing the Mean Squared Error (MSE) between differentially rendered images of the current volume estimate and reference projection images acquired at various rotation angles.
summary: Differential Rendering for CT Reconstruction is an inverse rendering technique that reconstructs volumetric absorption coefficients from 2D X-ray projections using gradient-based optimization with a multi-view iterative rotation strategy.
